state.objective: Explain 100% CPU lockup on ingress gateway.

context.content: CPU flamegraph: 98.4% CPU in re.match regex pattern `^([a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$` matching input string 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!' in validation.py:31
Ingress worker count: 8 workers, Nginx frontend reverse proxy.
Worker PID 14002 unresponsiveness watchdog triggered kill -9.

submitted_answer.answer: The ingress worker is stuck in catastrophic regex backtracking in validation.py:31. The nested quantifiers in `^([a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$` cause exponential work when a long valid-looking string ends with an invalid character (`!`), pegging the CPU until the watchdog kills the worker.
